definition: Instructions hidden in content a model reads, such as a web page, email or tool result, that make it act against the user's or developer's intent.
definitionZh: 藏在模型讀取的內容（例如網頁、電子郵件或工具回傳結果）中的指令，使模型違背使用者或開發者的意圖行事。

definition: Prompt injection delivered through third-party content the system retrieves, rather than typed by the user.
definitionZh: 透過系統擷取的第三方內容傳入、而非由使用者直接輸入的提示注入。

definition: Input crafted to make a model ignore its safety training or usage policy. A universal jailbreak works across many requests.
definitionZh: 刻意設計、讓模型忽略其安全訓練或使用政策的輸入；通用越獄可對大量請求生效。

definition: Corrupting training or fine-tuning data so a model learns a hidden behaviour or performs worse.
definitionZh: 污染訓練或微調資料，使模型學到隱藏行為或效能下降。

definition: A behaviour planted in a model that appears only when a specific trigger is present.
definitionZh: 植入模型中、只有在特定觸發條件出現時才會顯現的行為。

definition: Copying a model's capabilities by querying it at scale and training another model on the answers.
definitionZh: 大量查詢模型，並用其回答訓練另一個模型，藉此複製其能力。

definition: Giving an AI system more tools, permissions or autonomy than its task needs, so a manipulated or mistaken model can do real damage.
definitionZh: 賦予 AI 系統超出任務所需的工具、權限或自主性，使遭操縱或出錯的模型能造成實際損害。

definition: A model that plans and takes actions through tools, such as browsing, running code or calling APIs, with some autonomy.
definitionZh: 能規劃並透過工具（例如瀏覽網頁、執行程式碼或呼叫 API）採取行動、具一定自主性的模型。

definition: An open protocol that connects AI applications to tools and data sources through servers.
definitionZh: 透過伺服器將 AI 應用程式連接到工具與資料來源的開放協定。

definition: A control outside the model that inspects inputs or outputs and blocks or changes them according to a policy.
definitionZh: 位於模型之外、依政策檢查輸入或輸出並加以阻擋或修改的控制機制。

definition: Structured adversarial testing of an AI system to find failures before attackers or users do.
definitionZh: 以結構化的對抗測試找出 AI 系統的缺陷，搶在攻擊者或使用者之前發現問題。

definition: A machine-readable record of the models, datasets and components in an AI system, extending the software bill of materials.
definitionZh: 記錄 AI 系統中模型、資料集與元件的機器可讀清單，為軟體物料清單（SBOM）的延伸。

definition: Signed metadata, such as C2PA Content Credentials, that records where a piece of media came from and how it was edited.
definitionZh: 記錄媒體來源與編輯歷程的簽章中繼資料，例如 C2PA 內容憑證。

definition: One of the most capable general-purpose models available at a given time, often subject to extra safety and security commitments.
definitionZh: 當下能力最強的通用模型之一，通常須遵守額外的安全與資安承諾。
